title: narcissus × incomparabilis subsp. aranensis
intro: Narcissus × incomparabilis subsp. aranensis, commonly known as the Spanish Bluebells, is a hybrid plant belonging to the Amaryllidaceae family. The Spanish Bluebells have been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to their potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cognitive function. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids such as galanthamine and homohalanthamine, that exhibit neuroprotective and anti-inflammatory properties. These constituents are believed to contribute to the plant's potential therapeutic applications in treating neurodegenerative diseases and other conditions associated with oxidative stress and inflammation.
